risks.risk: Engine identity (make/model/engine code) is not readable, so the exact replacement/compatibility and market comparables can’t be confirmed.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine nameplate/engine code (stamped on block or on a label) plus the full engine from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case for an unknown used engine: treat as not confirmed for compatibility and not confirmed to be in top condition.

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” cannot be verified from a single still image.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the engine starting and running (cold start if possible) with a mechanic’s stethoscope check for knock and/or OBD scan results.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: needs further testing/possible faults).

risks.risk: “Low mileage / never opened” cannot be verified remotely without mileage proof and inspection evidence.
risks.proof: Photos of service/mileage documentation (if any) and close-ups of fasteners/seals for signs of prior opening (e.g., valve cover, timing cover area, head bolts/sealant).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially higher mileage and/or previously opened (worst-case condition).

risks.risk: Possible missing parts or damage not visible in the photo (belts, sensors, alternator/AC compressor, wiring connectors, mounts).
risks.proof: A checklist photo: show all accessories and connectors, including alternator, starter, sensors, mounts, and any included parts list.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming missing/unknown accessories may require replacement.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/nameplate (stamped/label) and a wider shot showing the full engine assembly.
Video of the engine starting and running, plus a brief mechanic check for knock (stethoscope) and any diagnostic/OBD readout.
Photos showing mileage proof (if available) and evidence whether it has been opened (timing/valve cover/sealant areas).
A photo inventory of included parts/accessories and confirmation of what is included/excluded.
response.reason: The photo shows an engine, but the exact identity and the seller’s key condition claims (tested/no knock/low mileage/never opened) are not verifiable from the single image. Without engine code and proof of running/diagnostics, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
